notes:
v1.11.0 Release:
- VoxCPM2 voices sound like the actor: each line of 1.6 s or more is cloned from the actor saying that very line, so the dub follows their pitch and feeling. One voice per actor in every feeling
- VoxCPM2 lines are about 4x faster, and each line is as loud as the actor said it
- Generate All and Dub Whole Series now send each line's emotion (they were all Neutral) and find the speakers first
- Better Khmer reading: ៖, ។ល។, ព.ស. / គ.ស. and other abbreviations, dates, currencies (USD, KHR, baht, yuan, euro, pound), 5G, ok
- Much faster exports with a video banner: it is keyed once and only for the time it shows (a 1-minute 1080p episode: 22.6 s to 9.7 s)
- Faster Dub Whole Series export with sponsor ads: each ad is encoded once and reused, and only the part around an ad is re-encoded
- NVIDIA graphics on laptops is found more reliably for fast exports

Also new since v1.6.0:
- v1.10.0: sponsor overlays and ads for Dub Whole Series; the export matches the editor
- v1.9.0: emotions for imported SRTs and on the voice pill, VoxCPM2 Khmer voice, series export folder
- v1.8.0: VoxCPM2 voice capture and voice groups, Fix Rushed Lines, Khmer pronouns, series image overlay
- v1.7.0: Khmer interface, Join into one video with clips, Gemini model changes
